data.narrative:
Arxlight is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Sagar Patel and Paul White. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies, supplemented by reference to a broader universe of 8 private frontier-defense firms and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

The peer-median method anchors the analysis. The four direct comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yield a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This method is applicable given the tight filtering on sector and stage proximity. No additional valuation methods are currently supported by the data provided, limiting triangulation depth to a single approach.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. This narrow band reflects the peer-median estimate with modest adjustment tolerance. Key uncertainties include the heterogeneity within the peer set (Series A valuations spanning a 32x range from NODA AI to Stark Defence), the lack of revenue or growth metrics to calibrate stage-appropriate discounts, and limited data on Arxlight's specific technology differentiation or market position relative to peers. A second valuation method would substantially improve confidence in this range.
